body:
[Trip report - Male/5'9'/160lbs, Oral dose, capsule, 55mg]
Dosage weight was determined with an accurate milligram scale and product was placed in '00' capsules.
**Note: I am a regular cannabis smoker and I was vaporizing hash oil every hour or so throughout the night.  The cannabis definitely enhanced the effects as well as added a relaxing element to the experience.**
Previous MXE experience: insufflation only, various dosages between 10mg and 100mg
Previous drug experience: Marijuana, LSD, Mushrooms, 5-MeO-DiPT, 2-CT-7, 2-CB, 2-CI, Methamphetamine, Amphetamines (multi), Cocaine, MDMA, Opiates (multi), Benzos (multi), GBL, GHB, Salvia, N2O.
T+00:00 - Went to the STS9 outdoor show and dropped the capsule when we got out of the car and started walking to the line (~7:30pm). L (female) dosed 22mg in a capsule as well at the same time.
T+00:45 - Slightly giggly, still standing in a long line people watching. Getting slightly fidgety, but I'm also watching security pat people the fuck DOWN. I've got Xanax, more MXE in in small baggie, and my mini-vaporizer, so this could all be attributed to me just not wanting to have to throw all my shit away/go to jail.
T+01:00 - We find a spot and get settled. L runs to the bathroom before the show and the full effects start to take hold while I await her return. I make friends with our party neighbors and everything seems copacetic.  Waves of relaxation.
T+01:30 - L finds me and I head off to the bathroom. Things get really weird, really quick (for both of us, apparently). No anxiety, just amazingly out of touch with reality. I can only describe the feeling as high-dose insufflated ketamine without the constant redosing requirement to stay at this level.
T+01:45 - Insanity. Chaos. We don't care, dancing and music are wonderful. Difficulty balancing, but other than that no 'negative' effects.  I need to pee but I hold it because it's just too difficult to reach the bathrooms right now, both due to the drug and to the environment.
T+02:00 - Effects come in waves now and are _somewhat_ controllable.  Effects seem to become more pronounced as the crowd and music gets more amped.
T+02:30 - Happy, but no longer in the crazy headspace I had been in. I've been smoking weed and vaping hash oil all night out of habit, but this was the first time that I sat back, took a hit, and 'got high.' Back to dancing. L mentions the same feeling of 'that was intense, now it's just kinda trippy.'
[Erowid Note: 
Driving while intoxicated, tripping, or extremely sleep deprived is dangerous and irresponsible because it endangers other people.
Don't do it!
]
T+03:00 - I can tell the show is going to end within the next 45 minutes, and I'm quickly sobering up to the point of drivability anyway, so we pack up and head to the car. Still shocked at how quickly the peak executed and decayed, but this is definitely a plus in my book.
T+4:30 - Writing this report. Relaxed, surprisingly awake (L felt the need to pass out immediately), with absolutely no negative after effects. At this point in any night like this I would at least expect a mild headache, but I'm completely comfortable other than maybe slight dehydration from dancing. About to fire up a mindless xbox game and get high.
Overall, this ROA far surpassed both my and L's expectations. I'd only done MXE nasally, and L had only done it sublingually. We both agree that this is by far the best ROA for any extended event. I would have even considered redosing orally at T+02:00 if I didn't have to drive home. I will certainly be testing the effects of oral dosing at lower levels for comparison to nasal soon.
